services.desc: BECKY SUSSNight House513 W 20th Street, New York, NYSeptember 10 - October 31, 2026Opening reception Thursday, September 10 from 6-8PMPRESSNew York Magazine Jack Shainman Gallery is pleased to present Night House, an exhibition of new work by Becky Suss that continues her exploration of interiority, domesticity and memory. Through paintings of imagined spaces and intimate vignettes, the exhibition marks a departure for Suss in her use of the darkness and quietude of the night as a lens through which to consider the emotional and psychological resonance of space.
